name: OrefinderEstimate
summary: Fast offline Minecraft ore estimator (best mining Y + likely ore areas).
description:
A fast, offline, dependency-free Minecraft ore estimator for Swift. Given a
seed label, version, and player position it returns the best mining Y and the
areas where an ore is most likely to concentrate, for Java and Bedrock.

Pure statistics over published Y-distribution ranges; deterministic and runs
entirely offline. For pinpoint, seed-exact coordinates and structures, pair it
with the Minecraft Ore Finder at https://orefinder.io
